name: Genomic Valley Biotech Ltd
summary: Genomic Valley Biotech Limited operates in horticulture business activities in India. The company involved in the commercial greenhouse/poly house cultivation of crops; commercial horticulture activities with aloe vera, tomato, bitter gourd, bottle gourd, brinjal, broccoli, cabbage, capsicum, carrot, cauliflower, cucumber, green chilies, onion, radish, ridge/sponge gourd, leafy vegetables, pumpkin, banana, guava, papaya, and strawberry; and commercial floriculture of flowers. It undertakes contracts for its clients for erecting greenhouses; and provides turnkey consultancy services. In addition, the company manufactures and markets bio-fertilizers; and offers farmer support apps. Further, it is involved in the operation of plant tissue culture process laboratory to produce tissue cultured plantlets. Genomic Valley Biotech Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Jhajjar, India.
